decisions.reason: This consumer superfood drink is the weakest fit with the firm's core waste-to-energy and engineering knowledge base, so under an absorptive-capacity logic it is the hardest product for the firm to learn around and improve commercially.
Modular waste-to-energy plant extensions build directly on the firm's existing engineering, automation and decentralized energy capabilities, making them a natural area to retain and refine.

As a stated flagship waste-oil-to-energy offering, this product sits close to the firm's core knowledge and R&D direction, so management would be inclined to keep developing it rather than withdraw it.

Plastic-waste-to-fuel technology is strategically aligned with the firm's sustainability platform and flagship ambitions, though its greater technical and market uncertainty makes it somewhat more droppable than the waste-oil system.
